# TypeUnsafeComparison

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Type compatibility](/rules/#type-compatibility) · PhpStorm name: `TypeUnsafeComparisonInspection`

Loose equality (`==`, `!=`, `<>`) silently juggles types (`'abc' == 0` was
true before PHP 8, `'1e1' == '10'` is true). This rule asks for strict
comparison, offers a one-click switch when comparing against a non-numeric
string literal, and flags objects compared to strings that have no
`__toString()`.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{13,15,17,19,20,21,23,24,26,27,28,29,30} [Before]
<?php
interface Labelled            { public function __toString(); }
interface Plain               {}
abstract class BaseTag        { abstract public function __toString(); }
class Tag extends BaseTag     { function __toString(): string { return "t"; } }
class ChildTag extends Tag    {}
class Invoice                 {}
class Stamp extends DateTimeImmutable {}

function compare(Labelled $l, Plain $p, ChildTag $t, Invoice $i, ?Invoice $n, $v, $w) {
    return [
        $l == 'x',
        $p != 'x',
        'name' == $t,
        '0' == $i,
        ($n) <> '',
        $n == 'paid',

        $v == 'ready',
        "done" != $v,
        $v<>'1x3',

        $v == '1e3',
        $v == "{$w}",

        $v == '12',
        $v != '-.5',
        $v == "",
        $v <> $w,
        $v == ('text'),

        new Stamp() == new DateTime(),
        date_create('now') != $w,
        $v === 'ready',
    ];
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
interface Labelled            { public function __toString(); }
interface Plain               {}
abstract class BaseTag        { abstract public function __toString(); }
class Tag extends BaseTag     { function __toString(): string { return "t"; } }
class ChildTag extends Tag    {}
class Invoice                 {}
class Stamp extends DateTimeImmutable {}

function compare(Labelled $l, Plain $p, ChildTag $t, Invoice $i, ?Invoice $n, $v, $w) {
    return [
        $l == 'x',
        $p != 'x',
        'name' == $t,
        '0' == $i,
        ($n) <> '',
        $n == 'paid',

        $v === 'ready',
        "done" !== $v,
        $v!=='1x3',

        $v == '1e3',
        $v == "{$w}",

        $v == '12',
        $v != '-.5',
        $v == "",
        $v <> $w,
        $v == ('text'),

        new Stamp() == new DateTime(),
        date_create('now') != $w,
        $v === 'ready',
    ];
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 13: \Plain has no __toString(), so it cannot be compared to a string.</li>
<li>line 15: \Invoice has no __toString(), so it cannot be compared to a string.</li>
<li>line 17: \Invoice has no __toString(), so it cannot be compared to a string.</li>
<li>line 19: Use &#39;===&#39; here; the string is not numeric, so strict comparison is safe.</li>
<li>line 20: Use &#39;!==&#39; here; the string is not numeric, so strict comparison is safe.</li>
<li>line 21: Use &#39;!==&#39; here; the string is not numeric, so strict comparison is safe.</li>
<li>line 23: Prefer &#39;===&#39; to avoid implicit type juggling.</li>
<li>line 24: Prefer &#39;===&#39; to avoid implicit type juggling.</li>
<li>line 26: Prefer &#39;===&#39; to avoid implicit type juggling.</li>
<li>line 27: Prefer &#39;!==&#39; to avoid implicit type juggling.</li>
<li>line 28: Prefer &#39;===&#39; to avoid implicit type juggling.</li>
<li>line 29: Prefer &#39;!==&#39; to avoid implicit type juggling.</li>
<li>line 30: Prefer &#39;===&#39; to avoid implicit type juggling.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "TypeUnsafeComparison": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore TypeUnsafeComparison

/**
 * @noinspection TypeUnsafeComparisonInspection
 */
```
